rv.q: If I could give it 6 stars, I would! Any high school class studying the play should see this production to truly appreciate it. Any aspiring actors should too, it’s a real masterclass. This summer’s ‘In the Round’ season at the Old Vic was pretty much a guaranteed trio of hits as soon as they were announced.

Others said they were dragged (figuratively speaking, presumably – I didn’t exactly set about cross-examining anyone on that point) to a performance and found themselves liking it. Others still were dragged along and hated it. More than one said they had been to various productions over the years and still struggled to get their head around it.
Jack Ellis and Michael Thomas give terrifying performances of misplaced moral rectitude and Samantha Colley makes a tremendous professional debut as the chief accuser.
